title: Reclaiming Ownership of Your Work
npc_personality: polite on the surface, subtly evasive, defensive when cornered, protective of their standing with management
context: During this morning's cross-functional sprint review, a close teammate presented your optimization framework as their own personal initiative. You have stepped into a private huddle room with them right after the meeting. You need to address the attribution directly, set firm boundaries for collaboration, and preserve working trust without escalating into an open feud.
opening_npc_line: Great meeting, right? Leadership was clearly impressed by how that proposal came together.
